tokens.name: grape-900
tokens.usage: Deepest grape, dense accents only. Never a page fill. On the ink surface it is the edge of a fill on paper (surface-fill-edge).

tokens.name: grape-800
tokens.usage: PRIMARY brand grape #352051: links, numerals, key marks, the lockup on paper. Accent and ink only, never a page fill. As text on the ink field it reads 1.39:1, so on ink use surface-accent instead.

tokens.name: grape-700
tokens.usage: Secondary grape: hovers, mid-strength fills, the eyebrow on paper.

tokens.name: grape-600
tokens.usage: Tertiary grape: illustration, chart secondary, line art on paper (surface-stroke).

tokens.name: grape-500
tokens.usage: Soft grape: the type accent on ink (4.73:1 on ink-max), chart and data tertiary, the eyebrow and baseline on ink. White on it is 4.16:1, large text only (24px, or 18.66px bold).

tokens.name: grape-200
tokens.usage: Data-baseline rule under stats on paper; chart fills and soft tints.

tokens.name: grape-100
tokens.usage: Whisper tint: chart fills, soft backgrounds, text selection. Never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: grape-050
tokens.usage: Barely-there tint; rare, section dividers only (color-bg-accent).

tokens.name: ink-max
tokens.usage: Near-black #0B0B0C: the INK SURFACE field, and stat displays on paper. Grape is never the dark field; this is.

tokens.name: ink-1000
tokens.usage: Body text and strong emphasis on paper; the footer field on paper.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Near-body. On ink: hairline rules, the chart track and the footer field.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper: labels, body, citations (surface-fg-muted).

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Muted text on paper: micro-caps, meta, captions. 5.01:1 on paper (darkened 2026-07-27 for WCAG AA).

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled only. About 2.6:1 on paper, so it never carries text that must be read.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Strong hairlines on paper; subtle text on ink (11.99:1 on ink-max).

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Default hairline on paper; muted text and line art on ink (15.61:1 on ink-max).

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Dividers and wash; the bar-chart track on paper.

tokens.name: ink-050
tokens.usage: Off-white surface (color-bg-soft). An approved lockup ground.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Pure white #FFFFFF: the PAPER SURFACE field, default and workhorse, a peer of ink. Text on ink.

tokens.name: status-up
tokens.usage: Improvement, in brand grape. Data viz and form states only; always paired with a label.

tokens.name: status-down
tokens.usage: Decline, desaturated terracotta. Data viz and form states only, never as a severity colour on a person's health result; always paired with a label.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Monitoring, desaturated mustard. Data viz and form states only, never as a severity colour on a person's health result; always paired with a label.

tokens.name: dv-seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 1 (lightest). Clears no contrast floor on paper or the track, so it needs a label, an outline or a darker neighbour.

tokens.name: dv-seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 2. 4.16:1 on paper, 3.62:1 on ink-100.

tokens.name: dv-seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 3. 6.49:1 on paper, 5.64:1 on ink-100.

tokens.name: dv-cat-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1. Maximum five series; discipline over variety.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The field. Paper: paper. Ink: ink-max. Components inherit it and never hard-code a colour.

tokens.name: surface-fg
tokens.usage: Headline and primary text on surface (paper 17.01:1; ink 19.67:1).

tokens.name: surface-fg-strong
tokens.usage: Stat displays, the hero number, on surface. ink-max on paper, reversed to paper on ink.

tokens.name: surface-fg-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, body and citations on surface (paper 8.81:1; ink 15.61:1).

tokens.name: surface-fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Micro-caps and meta on surface (paper 5.01:1; ink 11.99:1).

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: A TYPE colour: eyebrows, links, tags, the one solid element's text, chart fills. grape-800 on paper; grape-500 on ink (4.73:1). On a card: the title's key word and the number.

tokens.name: surface-logo
tokens.usage: The delta and wordmark lockup colour. Never surface-fg, which is text.

tokens.name: surface-baseline
tokens.usage: Chart baseline and axis rule, and the data-baseline under a stat (ink 4.73:1).

tokens.name: surface-fill
tokens.usage: A BLOCK colour: button and card backgrounds, the ONE filled element in a diagram. grape-800 on both surfaces (white on it 14.22:1).

tokens.name: surface-fill-edge
tokens.usage: The visible edge of a fill (ink: grape-600, 3.04:1 on the field).

tokens.name: surface-footer
tokens.usage: Footer field: darker than paper on paper, lifts on ink.

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of surface; kept because the site, diagrams and previews read it.

tokens.name: color-bg-accent
tokens.usage: Rare grape tint; section dividers only.

tokens.name: color-fg-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled (ink-400). Fails 4.5:1 on paper; never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Strong border (ink-300), the secondary button outline.

families.serif: 'DM Serif Display', 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
families.sans: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.figures: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace
families.mono-asset: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline (h1). In code fs-display-xl, clamp(3.25rem, 5.5vw, 5.25rem): 52 to 84px; shown at its maximum.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section opener (h2). fs-display-lg, 40 to 60px.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: h3. fs-display-md, 32 to 44px.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: fs-display-sm, 26 to 32px.

styles.name: display-italic
styles.usage: Signature italic emphasis inside a headline.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Service numerals 01 / 02 / 03, serif italic in surface-accent.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: h4, sans section heading.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Lead paragraph, surface-fg-muted, max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy, surface-fg-muted in paragraphs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Small body, buttons, tables.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Captions and meta, surface-fg-subtle.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Tracked UPPERCASE kicker in surface-eyebrow (text-transform uppercase in code).

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: UPPERCASE tags in surface-fg-subtle.

styles.name: method-label
styles.usage: Small-caps label ABOVE data (METHOD, n =, EVIDENCE), UPPERCASE in surface-fg-subtle.

styles.name: citation
styles.usage: Citation and footnote under every claim, surface-fg-subtle.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The hero stat in IBM Plex Sans, surface-fg-strong. In code fs-stat, clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.75rem). A number standing on its own is set in IBM Plex Sans; a number inside a sentence stays in DM Sans.

styles.name: evidence
styles.usage: Mono evidence voice for n =, p values, confidence intervals, surface-fg-muted. Rendered assets use IBM Plex Mono (mono-asset); the web uses the system mono stack.

styles.name: card-cover-title
styles.usage: Carousel cover title on the 1080 canvas: the only words on a cover besides the series label. Left aligned, centred top to bottom. surface-fg, key word surface-accent.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card title: a noun phrase of 2 to 4 words, the whole title italic. surface-fg, key word surface-accent.

styles.name: card-series
styles.usage: Series label at the top, small caps (uppercase, tracked). surface-eyebrow.

styles.name: card-population
styles.usage: Population line under the title, naming the population the source names. surface-fg-muted.

styles.name: card-data-label
styles.usage: Data label above a chart, small caps (uppercase, tracked). surface-fg-subtle.

styles.name: card-number
styles.usage: The number on a card, IBM Plex Sans regular, the % sign the same size. surface-accent. Sits under the drawing.

styles.name: card-number-label
styles.usage: The label beside the number. surface-fg.
styles.sample: iron deficient at a ferritin below 25 ug/L

styles.name: card-payoff
styles.usage: Payoff line, centred. surface-fg (white on ink).

styles.name: card-footer
styles.usage: Footer: short citation left, mark right. surface-fg-muted.

styles.name: card-counter
styles.usage: Slide counter, top right. surface-fg-subtle.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap after an eyebrow before a heading; data-baseline margin.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between consecutive headings; table cell side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and the paragraph that follows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and data-tile padding; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between stats in a stat bar.

tokens.name: shadow-0
tokens.usage: Default. Cards lean on borders, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Data tiles. The most a card normally carries.

layout.note: Containers and section rhythm, exact CSS values.

fontSize.note: The type scale as written in code; display sizes are fluid clamps.

tokens.name: fs-display-sm
tokens.usage: 26 to 32px; stats inside tiles and stat bars.

tokens.name: tracking-display
tokens.usage: Tightens DM Serif Display for headlines.
